text: …と　うけつけの　ねーちゃんが　いっとった　しんせつやのう

structure.jp: うけつけの　ねーちゃんが　いっとった
structure.en: the young lady at the counter was saying

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: と　うけつけの　ねーちゃんが　いっとった
patterns.explanation: と comes after the words someone said, and a verb of saying follows; here the quoted words are the line before. …と いっとった = 'that's what she said'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とった is an old-man, western-dialect way of saying ていた, 'was doing'. いっとった = 'was saying'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the western-dialect way of saying だ, 'it is', and のう is an old-man version of ね. しんせつやのう = 'how kind, eh'.
